summary:
Our project includes a Health Monitoring app that astronauts can use to check their Health status, if abnormal the system Alerts them and tells them to take the appropriate actions.

It has Heartbeat readings, Blood oxygen, Spacecraft cabin status etc....
details:
It uses sensor readings to determine how well is an astronaut physically and mentally this project aletrs the crew of the danger before it becomes too late,

we used HTML CSS JS FastAPI SQLite in the programs script it works effortlessly
